intro: Kyrgyz culture is rooted in nomadic life, from felt carpets to epic poetry.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: The yurt's round roof frame, the tunduk, is on the national flag. Shyrdak felt carpets and the white kalpak hat are symbols. Manaschi storytellers recite Manas from memory.

chapters.title: Food
text: Beshbarmak, plov, lagman and kymyz (fermented mare's milk) are favourites.
